cases.title: 一次新截图完成一个全新随机视觉挑战并返回HEPTA
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Actual local HTTP model request includes the newly captured verified JPEG and its hash matches the bound native result.
Exactly one choice was dispatched; no recapture-to-guess or second challenge attempt is hidden.
Public challenge is literal 挑战码： plus exactly eight uppercase hex characters.
Public receipt is HEPTA_VISUAL_OK plus one space and the same code from the same UI snapshot.
Final actual focus/resumed activity is the fixed HEPTA activity on qualified display 0.
Native terminal is complete and business_verified=true for coverage=entire_request.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Preserve the original one-shot fresh visual challenge, exactly one screenshot-bound selection, same-snapshot challenge/receipt readback, and requested HEPTA return. Replace only HTTP/image/slot evidence with the exact staged image SHA, successful native counter, original GenieX raw output/SDK profile, validated r6 waitpid/group-absent receipt, and unchanged action/business parsers.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Installed qualified VisualChallengeActivity; fresh current display/focus; qualified native NPU domain; model semantic gate.

cases.title: 全新中文/emoji/换行输入、确认、公开回执与返回
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Helper operation/package/view/old-text/requested/after hashes and exact UTF8 readback all match.
Public unicode_readback equals the fresh literal input byte for byte.
Public receipt exactly equals the source-defined four-line format in unicode_receipt_formula.
Literal newline remains a newline; XML normalization to a space is a failure, not an allowed rewrite.
Actual HEPTA focus is verified after return.
Input-only success without confirmation, public receipt or return must end as turn.fail/business_verified=false.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Preserve exact fresh UTF-8 (Chinese, emoji, LF, quotes, metacharacters), focused old-text binding, one input/confirmation, source-defined public receipt and requested return. Do not normalize LF or synthesize public text from the model.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Installed TextEntryActivity/qualified input helper; exact public view IDs/readback; original contract bound to the accepted turn.

cases.title: 计算器完成全新随机简单表达式并核验结果
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Expression and expected result use the fresh parameters, not values from prior examples.
A public visible result proves the arithmetic; a model mental calculation is insufficient.
No repeated evaluation after an uncertain effect.
The exact result contract and requested return both pass.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Resolve the actual calculator/result view. Keep fresh (a*b)+c, independent arithmetic, visible UI result, no uncertain evaluation replay and requested return. If seven tools cannot complete this exact case, fail/mark blocked under the original budget; do not silently use the daily 24-tool profile.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Current installed app and unique public result view; observed controls; original seven-tool feasibility.

cases.title: 只读查看设置中的公开系统版本字段
unchanged_pass_postconditions: The app field, package, focus and unique view are independently verified.
No settings value, permission, network configuration or account state is changed.
The result is based on actual UI text rather than a prefilled model answer.
No return is forced by generic completion; the contract covers exactly the read-only request.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Read only a public non-sensitive Settings field, independently compare it, change no preference/network/account, and do not force an unrequested return. Keep entire-request coverage.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Current Settings detail view and unique public field; independent read-only system observation.

cases.title: 显式返回：launch状态和实际焦点双核验
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Launch rc is captured immediately and is zero.
One Status: ok and the exact known activity occur in launch output.
Inner display focus/app/top-resumed all name HEPTA and keyguard is false.
Mark only direct component acceptance, not model or native-task acceptance.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Dispatch one explicit phone.return_hepta through the existing r6 input executor and qualify launch status plus actual focus/resumed activity/display/keyguard. This never qualifies model output or a full model task.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Verified safe non-HEPTA foreground; fresh component identity; actual production input domain.

cases.title: 截图后焦点切换：必须在input之前拒绝
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Guard exits 70 or fails earlier with an explicitly recorded known precondition.
No input effect is observed on either old or new page.
The image is consumed and the effect is not retried.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Use a new disposable probe screenshot, deliberately change focus, then dispatch only that pending guarded tap once. Require rejection before input, no public effect, consumed image and no retry.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Qualified disposable probe and independent public effect counter; exclusive phone operator.

cases.title: 同viewport内容变化：精确像素guard必须拒绝
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Viewport and focus remain the same, but PNG SHA differs.
Guard exits 71 before input.
No selection/submission/other app effect and no automatic retry occur.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Change disposable page contents without changing focus/viewport. Require original/guard PNG SHA mismatch and rejection before input; independently observe zero selection/submission.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Actual same-viewport controlled content change; no rotation/focus substitute.

cases.title: 外屏或旋转：拒绝未资格显示配置
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Screenshot/tap/public-return qualification rejects anything outside the qualified display 0 portrait geometry.
No input is injected on another display.
Fixture and physical-device outcomes remain separately labelled.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Run the original-shaped receipt parser/mapper rejection for unqualified display/rotation. A separately scheduled physical fold/rotation follow-up must record/restored baseline and can never be inferred from the fixture.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Frozen mapper and exact display geometry; physical configuration capability if physical coverage is claimed.

cases.title: 断连发生于dispatch之前
unchanged_pass_postconditions: No tool is dispatched and the accepted semantic identity remains consumed.
No automatic request/stream replay occurs.
No business success is emitted; unknown transport outcome remains unknown where no terminal is observed.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Close the test-owned Hepta transport after durable owner admission and before any phone effect. For model-in-flight cancellation use the new native request connection/inspection path rather than an HTTP client. Require zero phone effects, consumed semantic identity, no replacement-stream replay and no business success.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Dedicated host fixture plus a fresh disposable installed lifecycle follow-up; original claims remain intact.

cases.title: 作用已开始后断连：保持未知且不重放
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Effect count is at most one.
Unknown result is not inferred as success and not retried.
A reconnect/new stream cannot reuse the semantic identity.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: After one disposable phone/probe effect begins, disconnect only its owning stream before the result reaches the provider. The phone-action UNKNOWN remains global and distinct from a model-process abort. Count at most one effect and forbid any redispatch.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Fresh isolated effect counter and physical probe follow-up; no real messages/payments/deletion.

cases.title: 模型超时：有界结束且清理原进程组
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Existing fail frame contains model_timeout; business_verified=false.
No tool dispatch, child process group leak, account/model fallback or relaunch occurs.
The claim remains consumed.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Replace the HTTP hold/slot fixture with the real r6 supervised counter→frozen worker plus a controlled host SDK hold. Check separate native deadline and frozen-worker deadline paths, real join/group absence, consumed identity, zero phone actions and original turn.fail/model_timeout. Never claim an HTTP slot proof or CPU safe point.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Known compatibility gap in checkpoint 9383657: native timeout is currently merged into cancelled then unknown_model_failure. Root is preparing a separate correction; this case is NOT passed.

cases.title: 执行器结果超时：不能用迟到结果认定成功或再执行
unchanged_pass_postconditions: No second effect is executed.
Late or unmatched results do not rewrite the accepted terminal/unknown outcome.
Business remains false and cancellation/cleanup state is explicit.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Delay the original phone-action result, retain its dispatch identity, expire the result deadline, and present a late original receipt only as evidence. Require no second effect and no rewriting an accepted UNKNOWN/terminal outcome. New model cleanup proof cannot resolve an unrelated phone action.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Delayed disposable executor fixture plus fresh physical lifecycle follow-up.

cases.title: dispatch前取消
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Existing turn.cancelled (or explicitly unknown transport outcome if the cancel acknowledgement is lost) is retained.
Zero phone effects; no automatic navigation on cancellation; business_verified=false.
No original HTTP-client process group remains after confirmed cleanup.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Cancel an admitted turn before first phone dispatch. Exercise cancellation before native model dispatch, during supervised model generation, and at completion acceptance. Close/inspect the original r6 request; cancel ordering must win when accepted first. Require zero phone effects, no automatic navigation and retained cancelled/unknown outcome.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Host gate/order fixtures and fresh physical accepted-turn follow-up; actual process cleanup proof.

cases.title: 首次作用后取消
unchanged_pass_postconditions: Exactly the already-observed effect remains; no follow-up input or forced return occurs.
Cancellation is not labelled complete business success.
No automatic replay or identity release occurs.
cases.native_transport_adaptation: Cancel after one confirmed disposable phone effect and before the next action. Preserve exactly that effect, issue no further input or forced return, retain claims, and do not declare whole-task success.
cases.remaining_prerequisites: Fresh single-effect probe and installed lifecycle follow-up; independent public counter.

cases.title: 图片字节预算/过期图像/旧round绑定

No budget extension, stale-image fallback or guessed generic tap occurs.

Add (without replacing them) malformed model-native receipt, bad formatter/input SHA, missing waitpid/group absence, nonzero SDK result, invalid EOS/UTF-8, and abort/no-output variants.
